page.help: How punishments (warns, mutes, kicks and bans) work in this server: where they are written down, which roles show that someone is muted or warned, and how members can ask for a punishment to be lifted (an appeal). /enforcements in Discord uses these settings.

adminOnly: You need the Administrator permission in this server for this.

topic.whereLine: Where Mewvo writes about punishments, and the roles it uses.
topic.appealsLine: How members ask staff to lift a punishment.
topic.safetyLine: Shortcuts for moderators, and a brake if a moderator account is misused.
topic.pagesLine: Numbers about this server on the Mewvo website. Both are off by default.
topic.rulesLine: Built in. You cannot change these here yet.

channels.title: Channels
channels.help: Logs, evidence and the categories for appeals, reports and modmail.
channels.modLogHelp: Mewvo posts one line here for every warn, mute, kick and ban. Staff alerts also go here when no other channel is set.
channels.evidenceHelp: Screenshots added to a case are saved here, so they stay even if the original message is deleted. Not set: the mod log channel.
channels.adminRequestHelp: Where moderators ask an administrator to do something they cannot do themselves.
channels.appealsCategoryHelp: A category is a folder of channels. Each mute or warn appeal gets its own channel in it. Not set: the ticket category.
channels.reportsCategoryHelp: Each report about a staff member gets its own channel here. Not set: the ticket category.
channels.modmailCategoryHelp: When a member messages Mewvo privately and sends it to staff, the chat gets a channel here. Not set: the ticket category.
channels.openCapHelp: How many staff report and modmail channels can be open at the same time. When the limit is reached, new ones are turned away and staff get an alert. Appeals are never turned away.
channels.inviteHelp: A link to your support server. Banned members get it so they can still appeal.
channels.inviteRequired: The support server invite cannot be empty: paste a discord.gg invite link. Nothing was changed.

roles.title: Roles
roles.help: Warning roles show how many active warnings a member has. Mewvo gives and removes them by itself.
roles.mutedHelp: The role that stops a muted member from talking. If you leave this empty, Mewvo makes one the first time someone is muted.
roles.quarantineHelp: Given instead of all other roles when someone is quarantined: by a raid, by the staff guard, or by hand on a member page. Mewvo hides every channel from it. Not set: raids kick and the staff guard removes staff roles, as before.
roles.quarantineHasPerms: The quarantine role has permissions of its own. Give it none: it should only take access away.
roles.quarantinePing: Head admin roles to ping when someone is quarantined (up to {max})
roles.quarantinePingHelp: The quarantine alert in the alerts channel mentions these roles, and nobody else. Hold Ctrl (Cmd on a Mac) to choose more than one.
roles.quarantineInfo: Quarantine info channel (quarantined members see only this, read-only)
roles.quarantineInfoHelp: Quarantined members can read this one channel but not post or react there. Not set: they see no channel at all.
roles.quarantineInfoPostHelp: Posts a message from Mewvo in the quarantine info channel that explains the quarantine to them (in the server language). Posting again replaces the old message.
roles.quarantineRefusePerms: The quarantine role must have no permissions of its own (every quarantined member would get them). Pick a role without any, or remove them in Discord first.
roles.quarantineRefuseHeld: Members already have this role ({count}): Mewvo hides every channel from it, so they would all lose access. Make a new empty role for quarantine.
roles.quarantineDeciders: Who can decide on quarantined members (up to {max} roles)
roles.quarantineDecidersHelp: Holders of these roles (and the server owner) choose Release, Kick, Ban or Keep for a quarantined member, on the alert or the member page. Other Administrators can quarantine but not decide. The ping roles above are separate.
roles.quarantineDecidersNone: None set yet: only the server owner decides.
roles.quarantineDecidersOwnerOnly: Only the server owner (or the bot owner in Mewvo’s servers) can change who decides.

timings.title: Appeals and reports
timings.help: An appeal is a member asking staff to lift a punishment.
timings.windowHelp: How long after a punishment a member can still ask for it to be lifted.
timings.cooldownHelp: If staff say no to an appeal, the member has to wait this long before appealing again. 0 means no wait.
timings.rejoinHelp: Kicked members and members whose appeal was accepted get a one-time invite link back. This is how long it works.
timings.staleReportHelp: A report channel where nobody has written for this long is closed.
timings.staleAppealHelp: If an appeal has no decision and no new messages for this long, staff get a reminder and the member is told it is still open.

review.title: Independent appeal review
review.help: Off by default, so any staff member who handles appeals can decide any appeal.
review.label: A different moderator decides each appeal
review.labelHelp: The moderator who gave the punishment cannot accept or deny the appeal against it. Someone else on the staff has to. The bot owner can still decide in an emergency, and that is logged. Punishments Mewvo gave by itself (automatic warn bans, automod) are not affected.

mass.title: Safety limit: too many bans or kicks in a short time
mass.help: Protects the server if a moderator account is misused (default: more than 5 bans or kicks in 10 minutes). A moderator who punishes too many members in a short time is stopped for a while, and the bot owner gets a private message (DM).
mass.limitHelp: How many one moderator can do within the time below.
mass.muteLimitHelp: Counted separately from bans and kicks.
mass.blockHelp: How long a moderator who goes over the limit cannot punish anyone.

templates.title: Templates
templates.help: Ready-made punishments for /enforcements, like "Spam: 1h mute". They show as a menu under the buttons. Picking one skips straight to the last step, where you confirm.
templates.name: Name
templates.max: You have the maximum of {count} templates.
templates.nameHint: The name staff see in the menu.
templates.durationHint: How long it lasts, for example 1h (one hour) or 7d (seven days). A mute needs one. A ban with no duration is permanent. Warns and kicks ignore it.

panels.title: Appeal panels
panels.help: Posts the appeal panel here and in the support server, and removes the old ones. You can also do this with /setappeal in Discord.
panels.helpServer: Posts the appeal panel in the channel you pick and removes the old one there. Members press it to appeal a punishment from this server or to report a staff member; each appeal opens in a private channel of your appeals category. No category yet? Mewvo creates a private “Appeals” category. You can also do this with /setappeal in Discord.
panels.channelHelp: The appeal panel is a message with a button members press to appeal. A second panel goes to #appeals in the support server, which Mewvo creates if it does not exist.
panels.channelHelpServer: The appeal panel is a message with a button members press to appeal. Pick a channel your members can read.
panels.confirm: Post the appeal panels now? Earlier appeal panels in these channels are replaced.
panels.confirmServer: Post the appeal panel now? An earlier appeal panel in this channel is replaced.

pages.transparencyHelp: A monthly count of warnings, mutes, kicks, bans and appeals at /transparency.
pages.transparencyMore: It shows numbers only. No names, IDs, case codes, reasons or moderators. A count of 1 or 2 shows as “fewer than 3”.
pages.transparencyToggle: Publish a monthly transparency report on the website
pages.transparencyOff: Take the transparency report off the website?
pages.trustHelp: A summary of the last 90 days at /trust.
pages.trustMore: How fast appeals get a first answer, how many are accepted, how many members are in good standing, and how often members fix a message themselves after automod warns them privately first. Numbers only. Counts of 1 or 2 and rates based on fewer than 3 are hidden.
pages.trustOff: Take the trust card off the website?

rules.ladderHelp: When warnings turn into a ban.
rules.ladderText: A member with no earlier ban is banned at {count} warnings. After that, each new warning bans them again, for longer each time.
rules.reasonsHelp: The reasons moderators can pick from.
rules.reasonsMore: They cannot be changed here yet, because each case saves the code of its reason.
rules.stepsHelp: What automod does when someone breaks the same rule again.

result.panelsPosted: Appeal panels posted in #{main} and in #{support} of the support server.
result.panelsPostedCreated: Appeal panels posted in #{main} and in #{support} of the support server (created).
result.panelPostedServer: Appeal panel posted in #{channel}. Appeals open in {category}.
result.panelPostedServerCreated: Appeal panel posted in #{channel}. Mewvo created the private category {category} for appeals and saved it as your appeals category.
result.templateGone: That template is gone already. Reload the page.
result.transparencyOn: The transparency report is on: /transparency is public.
result.transparencyOff: The transparency report is off: /transparency is gone from the website.
result.trustOn: The trust card is on: /trust is public.
result.trustOff: The trust card is off: /trust is gone from the website.
result.quarantineInfoNoChannel: Set a quarantine info channel (a text channel Mewvo can post in) first.
result.quarantineInfoPosted: The quarantine info message is posted in #{channel}.
result.quarantineInfoReplaced: The quarantine info message is posted in #{channel}; the old one was removed.

appealsHome.title: Where members appeal
appealsHome.help: Punishment messages (DMs) tell members where they can ask for a punishment to be lifted. Our own server (the default): the DM names your invite below and Mewvo’s web appeal page when it is available; with neither, it tells them to contact your staff. Mewvo support: they appeal in the Mewvo support server.
appealsHome.inviteHelp: A discord.gg invite that does not expire. Used only with “Our own server”. Empty: the DM has no invite line (it still links the web appeal page when available, else tells members to contact your staff).
appealsHome.badInvite: Invite to our own server: must be a discord.gg invite link. Nothing was changed.
appealsHome.homeNote: This does not apply here: members of Mewvo's own servers always appeal in the Mewvo support server.
appealsHome.homeOnlyAction: This setting does not apply in Mewvo's own servers. Nothing was changed.

ladderSettings.title: Warn ladder settings
ladderSettings.help: Whether warnings add up to automatic bans in this server. Warnings are always recorded and shown in the member’s record.
ladderSettings.enabled: Warn ladder: 3 warnings lead to an automatic ban
ladderSettings.enabledHelp: Off: warnings are still recorded and sent, but never ban anyone by themselves. Bans you give by hand are not affected.
ladderSettings.automod: Automod warnings count toward the warn ladder
ladderSettings.automodHelp: Off (the default in new servers): warnings automod gives on its own are recorded and shown as "automod warning — doesn’t count toward bans". On: three automod hits can mean an automatic 7-day ban.
ladderSettings.offNote: The warn ladder is off: no warning in this server leads to an automatic ban, so the automod setting has no effect right now.
